subject.title: [Bug]: Slack provider doesn't reliably reload after channels.slack.botToken rotation (cached singleAuthorization)

question: What proof is sufficient to queue a fix for the remaining Slack token reload miss?
rationale: Current source and release code cover the normal direct-edit and gateway write paths, while the only reported miss is environment/control-plane specific and a maintainer has already asked for evidence to choose the right layer.

options.title: Require container/control-plane reproduction first
options.body: Keep this issue open until logs and health state show whether the missed restart comes from the watcher, Control UI/config RPC, or filesystem/inode behavior.

options.title: Preemptively harden watcher behavior
options.body: Queue a watcher-focused fix without a fresh repro, accepting the risk that the Control UI/config-write path remains the real failure.

options.title: Fold into native token rotation direction
options.body: Treat this as part of the broader Slack OAuth rotation feature, accepting that manual token-string reload reliability remains unproven meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Require container/control-plane reproduction first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until logs and health state show whether the missed restart comes from the watcher, Control UI/config RPC, or filesystem/inode behavior.
